name: three_heights_in_one_step
why: BRIEF §5.2 (25/10/2026). On 24/10/2026 each half of a channel took six «extrude_profile», one per height. «extrude_regions» draws the regions of one plane at their heights in one step, and names the dimension of each height. Two plates side by side, 50 x 40 at 10 mm and at 20 mm, and a square 20 x 20 at 30 mm on the first: 20000 + 40000 + 8000 = 68000 mm3 (computed by script), one body. Then the height of the second region, by the name the answer gave, to 25 mm: 78000 mm3.
defect_caught: A region drawn at the height of another; a depth dimension named after another feature; a refusal that leaves the regions before it in the part.

expect.why: the regions touch, so they merge
read from the feature of the second region
only the second region grows: 50 x 40 x 5 more
